basic_reproduction_number.description: Basic reproduction number: transmission rate over recovery rate
basic_reproduction_number.validation: R₀ > 1 predicts epidemic spread; R₀ < 1 predicts extinction
basic_reproduction_number.interpretation: Average number of secondary infections per infected individual

sir_susceptible.description: SIR susceptible compartment: depletion by mass-action infection
sir_susceptible.validation: Population conserved: S + I + R = N

sir_infected.description: SIR infected compartment: new infections minus recoveries
sir_infected.validation: Peak infection timing matches data for COVID-19, 1918 flu

sir_recovered.description: SIR recovered compartment: inflow from recovery

population_conservation.description: Total population is conserved across S, I and R

endemic_equilibrium.description: Final-state susceptible and recovered populations for R_0 > 1

seir_exposed.description: SEIR exposed compartment: new infections minus progression to infectious

attack_rate.description: Attack rate: fraction of the population ever infected
attack_rate.validation: Predicted attack rate vs observed seroprevalence studies

stochastic_seir_transitions.description: Stochastic SEIR: Poisson-distributed S→E transitions per time step, capped by the compartment size
stochastic_seir_transitions.validation: Integer counts sum to N at every step of every run

stochastic_seir_reproducibility.description: Stochastic SEIR ensemble: a fixed seed reproduces every run exactly
stochastic_seir_reproducibility.validation: Same seed yields identical ensemble arrays
